title: Run the frame scripts in the bee-design Check step when a page moves
action: In the Check step of packages/bee/design/bee-design/SKILL.md, add a rule: when the page has motion (animation, transition, scroll or hover states), and bee-design-motion is installed with a browser and playwright-core present, run its sheet.mjs and jumps.mjs on the page, look at the sheet, and fix every jump; when any of those is missing, list motion under NOT_VERIFIED with the reason. Add a MOTION field to the hand-over block. Then run bee dev regen.
